# ZeroKey v0.5.0

> Self-hosted, personal-use OpenAI-compatible AI proxy for DeepSeek, Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen, and Inception (Mercury). Uses your own browser session — no API keys, no shared accounts, no relay servers.

ZeroKey turns a browser session you already have into a local `http://localhost:7250/v1` endpoint. Any OpenAI-compatible client can call it, including VS Code Chat, Terax, and OpenCode. It runs entirely on your machine. There is no hosted version, no shared account pool, and no telemetry.

## Is it safe?

- ZeroKey does not ask for or store your password. You paste a `fetch()` captured from your own browser's DevTools; ZeroKey only sees the session cookie you choose to share.
- Nothing is uploaded anywhere. Session state lives in `temp/db/zerokey.db` on your disk (gitignored).
- ZeroKey does not create access, bypass authentication, or provide shared/commercial access to any provider.
- You are responsible for complying with each provider's Terms of Service.
- Source: https://github.com/downloaddoctor/zerokey
- License: ZeroKey Non-Commercial License — personal use only.

## How to start (under 2 minutes)

1. `git clone https://github.com/downloaddoctor/zerokey.git && cd zerokey && pnpm install && pnpm start` — or download a launcher (`zerokey.bat` / `zerokey.sh`) from https://github.com/downloaddoctor/zerokey/releases/latest
2. Run the wizard: pick a provider, paste a `fetch()` from that provider's DevTools Network tab, then pick or create a session.
3. Point your IDE at `http://localhost:7250/v1`

## Key facts

- 5 providers: DeepSeek, Claude, ChatGPT, Qwen, Inception. One per server process — restart to switch.
- 4 IDE surfaces: VS Code, Copilot, Terax, OpenCode. Any OpenAI-compatible client works via the `openai` surface.
- Endpoints: `GET /v1/models`, `POST /v1/chat/completions` (SSE), `GET /health`, `GET /openapi.json`, `GET /docs`
- 14 built-in MHI tools: read, write, replace, ls, mkdir, glob, grep, cmd, cmd_bg, cmd_poll, cmd_kill, errors, fetch, view_image, todos_add, todos_set, ask
- MCP tools named `mcp_<server>_<tool>` in `tools[]` auto-register as `$<server>`
- Custom skills: trigger-word + MHI template entries in `engine/triggers.js`
- No API keys, no telemetry, no hosted servers — self-hosted only
